text: D210712 requests present-indicative method docs, accurate stored-value descriptions, and API functionality rather than this-is-for-Auth consumer references. Current provider documents unsupported-domain None and retrieved values. Some current prose still uses imperative Generate, so present-indicative is a scoped proposed editorial rule, not perfect repository consistency. Use full initialize rather than init in prose while preserving exact identifiers.
title: Describe API behavior and returned values rather than bind docs to one consumer
